technique_de_realisation: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water for 10-15 minutes. When cooked drain well.
Place milk in double boiler and bring to a scald.
Place butter in top section of double boiler over direct heat. When melted, add onions and cook until transparent.
Add cooked potatoes, creamed corn and scalded milk to onions.
Place in bottom part of double boiler filled 1/3 with boiling water and heat through.
